name: Viktor
description: An AI coworker that lives in Slack, writes code, and connects to 3,000 tools. It executes tasks end-to-end with persistent workspace context and proactive automation capabilities.
community_quotes: Viktor automates tasks, writes code, connects to 3,000 tools, and gets things done — not just answers questions

name: Coder Agents

name: ClawTick
